title: Ashfall County
brief: Survive the dead in a seeded 3 km x 3 km rural county: scavenge homes and stores, manage hunger, thirst, fatigue and wounds, barricade a safehouse, and reach the evacuation convoy at the Ash River bridge, or keep surviving after it leaves.

world.contents: Ash River with sand banks and a highway bridge, county highway and Route 9, a county seat (Cedar Fork) plus towns and hamlets scaled to map size, farms with barns and fenced fields, forests, ponds, roadside homes and abandoned cars.
rules: Zombie spawns are land-only: never water, walls or furniture, never within 28 m of the start or inside the start house.
Population density follows zones: commercial > town > suburb > farm > wild > forest; water has none.
Containers roll loot lazily from the seed the first time anyone opens them.
Saves regenerate the county from its seed and store only changed state.
world.legacyNote: The previous three-chapter Frontier stages are retired from the build; their sources are kept in Legacy/.

player.name: Player-named survivor (default Mara Vale)
player.role: Profession chosen at New Game: paramedic, carpenter, sheriff's deputy, farmer, firefighter, line cook or unemployed; plus positive/negative traits within a point budget
player.movementDesignTarget: Isometric walk/run/sneak with wall sliding, window climbing and fence hopping; encumbrance, endurance and leg wounds slow movement.

npcs.name: Ada Pike
npcs.runtimePresence: Radio voice only; no runtime NPC body.
npcs.interactionsAcceptance: Broadcasts reach survivors carrying a hand radio; verify in native play.

npcs.name: Jonah Reed
npcs.runtimePresence: Radio voice and the evacuation outcome; no runtime NPC body.
npcs.interactionsAcceptance: Evacuation triggers within 14 m of the bridge rally point on the convoy day 08:00-14:00.

enemies.behaviour: Idle, wander, investigate noise, chase on sight, attack, thump doors/windows/barricades, climb open windows, knocked down by shoves and heavy weapons, eat the dead.
enemies.acceptance: Verify spawn rules, perception, pathing to openings, combat, animation and corpses natively.

story.premise: Ashfall County has been sealed by the Guard. Utilities fail within days. Ada Pike's emergency band and Jonah Reed's convoy offer one way out.
story.goal: Reach the Ash River highway bridge (west bank) on the configured evacuation day between 08:00 and 14:00. After the convoy leaves, free play continues; endless mode has no rescue.
events: Power and water shut-off on seeded days
Helicopter event on day 2-3 that draws zombies toward the survivor

studioIntro.creator: ProgrammingSecurely
studioIntro.presentation: Game title and creator credits over the actual scene when available; no fabricated gameplay video.

systems.coreLoop: Scavenge, eat and drink, avoid or fight the dead, treat wounds, fortify, sleep, and decide when to travel.
systems.needs: Hunger, thirst, fatigue, endurance, panic, pain, boredom, sickness, wetness, encumbrance; moodles in the HUD.
systems.health: Body-part wounds (scratch, laceration, bite, glass cut) that bleed, can be bandaged, disinfected, stitched and infected; zombie infection is fatal when enabled.
systems.combat: Melee weapons with arc, reach, knockdown and wear; shove; stomping downed zombies; firearms with ammo, reload, spread and very loud noise.
systems.noise: Footsteps, combat, glass, barricading, chopping and gunshots emit noise that zombies hear through walls at reduced range.
systems.resources: Weighted loot tables per room/container type; perishable food spoils (fridges slow it while the grid is up); tap water until shut-off, then stored pipe water (tainted), rain collectors (clean) and river water (tainted, boil it).
systems.crafting: Rags, planks, spear, spiked bat, campfire, rain collector, wooden crate, stew, first aid kit; barricading with hammer, plank and nails.
systems.skills: Melee, Aiming, Carpentry, Cooking, First Aid, Foraging, Sneaking, Fitness, Mechanics, Farming, Fishing, levelled by use.
systems.farming: Seed packets (carrot, potato, tomato, cabbage) from barns, hardware/tool stores, groceries and gone-to-seed field crops. Dig a plot with a shovel on grass, dirt or field ground outdoors, plant a packet, keep the soil watered (watering can or any water container; rain waters plots). Crops grow over 3-5 in-game days only while watered, wilt and die after about 30 dry hours, and rot if left ripe for 3 days. Harvest yields produce scaled by Farming skill and plant health, sometimes seed packets back. Host rules in Game/Assets/Ashfall/Core/SimSurvival.cs and Farming.cs.
systems.fishing: Fishing rod plus worms (foraged, dug up, gas-station bait; one per cast) or a reusable lure, from outdoor land within 2 m of the river or a pond. Catch chance rises with Fishing level, dawn/dusk and rain; perch, bass and catfish must be cooked (raw fish causes sickness). The rod wears with use.
systems.traits: Picked on the New Game screen with a 4-point budget: positive traits cost points, negative traits give points, opposite pairs exclude each other. Strong/Weak (capacity, melee, shove), Fast/Slow Learner (XP), Athletic/Out of Shape (run speed, endurance), Light Sleeper (wakes at 14 m), Eagle Eyed/Short Sighted (zombie visibility, mapping), Graceful/Clumsy (footstep noise), Light Eater/Hearty Appetite (hunger), Green Thumb (Farming +1, faster growth), Angler (Fishing +1, more bites), Smoker (starts with cigarettes; cravings raise panic and boredom after 8 hours). The host validates the selection again in World.Create.
systems.skillBooks: Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 handbooks for Carpentry, Cooking, First Aid, Foraging, Farming and Fishing. Reading (20 s, needs light) multiplies that skill's XP by 3 for levels 0-4 (Vol. 1) or by 4 for levels 5-9 (Vol. 2); the book is kept and cannot be studied twice.
systems.vehicles: About 40% of intact abandoned cars run (seeded per county). Keys in the ignition, the car's trunk or a nearby house container, or hotwire with a screwdriver (Mechanics). Host-side driving with fuel use, top speed by condition, slower off-road, collisions with walls, fences, water and props that damage the car, zombies knocked down or killed when hit at speed, engine noise that draws zombies, refuelling from gas cans or powered pumps; parked cars block their tiles. Game/Assets/Ashfall/Core/Vehicles.cs.
systems.interaction: E performs the focused action; Q opens every nearby action. All requests are host commands validated for reach, line of sight, tools and ownership.
systems.authority: Host-authoritative simulation (Simulation.Submit/SetInput). Clients would send input and commands only; LAN is not implemented for the rebuilt game.
systems.saves: Atomic, versioned, gzip-compressed seed + delta saves in the per-game persistent data directory (Survival/*.sav); autosave every 5 minutes, on sleep start and on quit. Save version 2 (farming, fishing, traits, skill books) refuses version 1 saves with an explanation and leaves the file untouched. Legacy Campaigns data is untouched.

playtime.designBasis: Default evacuation day 5 with 45-minute days is about 3.4 hours of in-game time before the convoy; endless survival continues afterwards.
playtime.freePlay: Endless survival after or instead of evacuation; sandbox options for population, speed, day length, utilities, loot, infection and migration.
playtime.acceptance: Measure normal play sessions; automated smoke duration and repeated captures do not establish playtime.

assets.policy: Use compatible owned art for characters, props, weapons, vehicles, animations, audio and HUD sprites. Keep gameplay logic, controls, collision and progression owned by the game; procedural stand-ins are used when a private pack is not restored.
assets.provenance: Hash-pin selected original files, licence source and native references. Owned/downloaded/candidate is not proof of runtime integration.
assets.runtimeBindings: Generated at build time: Game/Assets/Resources/AshfallArt.json (role -> prepared prefab) by Game/Assets/Editor/PrepareAshfallArt.cs
assets.licenceNotes: Leartes glass-break WAVs: confirm the licence allows non-Unreal use before shipping.

requiredChecks: Native new game on each county size: generation, start house, spawn clearance and water exclusion
Keyboard/mouse and physical controller: movement, aiming, combat, interaction and every menu
Looting, eating, drinking, cooking, crafting, barricading, sleeping, wounds and treatment
Farming over in-game days, fishing and cooking fish, trait selection and effects, skill books and smoking; save/reload of plots, traits and read books
Zombie perception, pathing to doors and windows, thumping, climbing, combat and corpses
Drivable cars: enter/exit, keys and hotwiring, driving and steering, fuel and refuelling, collisions, running down zombies, engine audio and save/reload
Evacuation outcome on the convoy day, death outcome, save/reload and autosave
Purchased characters/items: import, runtime reference, animation and interaction
Measured playtime, performance in towns, platform builds, distribution signing and Steam acceptance
acceptance.latestValidation: Docs/ValidationReports; distinguish current native evidence from historical (Frontier-era) reports
